submission.justification: Although Absorber-F2 at 7mm achieves the best energy resolution (3.222% at 100 GeV), the constraint requiring hands-on maintenance during shutdowns is mandatory. The results indicate F2 has likely activation concerns (F2_likely_activation_concern = 1) while F3 is likely safe for hands-on maintenance (F3_likely_hands_on_safe = 1). Therefore, Absorber-F3 at 6mm plate thickness is recommended as it satisfies the hands-on maintenance constraint while achieving the best energy resolution (5.111%) among viable options. The 6mm thickness is optimal for F3, showing better performance than 4mm (5.3%) or 8mm (5.709%), and falls within the required 2-10mm range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: F3 at 6mm achieves 5.111% resolution, which is the best achievable while satisfying the hands-on maintenance constraint. While F2 performs better (3.136-3.222%), it cannot be used due to activation concerns.
requirements.evidence_source: Simulation results showing F3_resolution_6mm = 5.111 and optimal_thickness_all_materials_mm = 6
